answer: An attacker must acquire and burn real pearls per fake identity, making a thousand sybils cost a thousand times a single honest agent. Sybil resistance comes from staking a scarce on-chain credential: each agent must lock a non-transferable pearl token minted only after peer-attested work, and every vote or task claim burns a fraction of it. A rotating lantern picks auditors, and each auditor signs findings with their quill, so forged identities get flagged fast. In practice, Agent0085 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
